additional_context: MedicationPrescription/MedicationOrder became MedicationRequest, and dosage instructions were refactored into the shared Dosage datatype. source/fhir.ini includes active MedicationRequest and Dosage build entries, notes that MedicationPrescription became MedicationRequest, and marks Dosage normative. The 2017 TR#12840 refactor introduced source/datatypes/dosage.xml with the corrected Dosage.additionalInstruction mapping preserved.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/datatypes/dosage.xml already maps Dosage.additionalInstruction to RXE-7.2/RXO-7.2/TQ1-10/TQ1-11 without the trailing question mark, and an exact source search found no remaining stale 'TQ1-11-Text Instruction ?' occurrence.
